newsitem.title: USA: NORDIC SKIING-SKARD GETS HIS FIRST NORDIC COMBINED VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-SKARD GETS HIS FIRST NORDIC COMBINED VICTORY.

text.p: Skard earned the first nordic combined World Cup victoy of his
career Wednesday, leading a 1-2-3-4 Norwegian sweep of a
competition held in a persistent snowstorm.
Skard and countrymen Bjarte Engen Vik, Einar Trod Elden
and Knut Tore Apeland easily ran down Jari Mantila of Finland
in the 15-kilometre cross-country finale. Mantila, who won the
season's only other competition three weeks earlier, led again
after jumping, but faltered early in the runing.
Skard beat back Vik in a sprint to the finish, winning by
one-tenth of a second. Elden was far back, 52.9 seconds
behind, and Apeland trailed by 1:08.0. Mantila finished 1:20.9
behind on a course made difficult with heavy snow.
